decisions.rationale: Test fully set-based execution to drastically minimize buffer gets (f1), alongside moderate bulk and caching variants to map the memory vs. logical I/O trade-off curve across all three loops.
LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically cuts logical I/O at high PGA cost. Test caching on s1 alone or combined with SET_BASED/BULK variations to map intermediate points on the trade-off curve.
LOOKUP_CACHE drives high memory but slashes f1. Test BULK_5000 with LOOKUP_CACHE and explore intermediate memory points where only s2 or s4 caches without the other, combined with SET_BASED s5.
Test single-cache configurations and intermediate bulk sizes for s3 to explore the memory versus logical read frontier between 2.3MB and 15MB PGA.
Test hybrid setups where only s1 or s3 uses LOOKUP_CACHE alongside SET_BASED/BULK to find intermediate memory-vs-I/O points, plus BULK_50 with LOOKUP_SQL to check if memory drops even lower.
Test combinations of ROW/SET_BASED with BULK and LOOKUP_SQL to target low PGA with competitive f1, while checking if asymmetric ROW + BULK reduces PGA below 2304KB.
Test BULK_500/BULK_5000 on s1 with s3=SET_BASED and explore caching combinations between s1 and s3 to find memory-buffer tradeoffs under 16MB.
Test combinations pairing ROW or BULK_50 with LOOKUP_CACHE at s1 and s3 to find intermediate Pareto points between f1=2322 (16MB) and f1=4321 (15.6MB).

Test single-cache configurations (s2=LOOKUP_SQL, s4=LOOKUP_CACHE with s1=ROW/SET_BASED) and ROW/BULK_5000 combinations to explore intermediate memory trade-offs and potentially uncover lower f1 or tighter PGA boundaries.
Test single cache with ROW/BULK combinations and examine whether BULK_5000 on s3 with LOOKUP_CACHE and ROW on s1 lowers f1 below 3322 with moderate memory.
Test fully set-based execution to minimize consistent gets, plus intermediate bulk and lookup cache configurations to explore balanced memory versus buffer cache tradeoffs.
Test combination of SET_BASED across loops with LOOKUP_CACHE where applicable, and explore finer BULK limits paired with caching to find intermediate trade-offs between memory and gets.

Test BULK_5000 with LOOKUP_SQL to probe whether larger batch sizes improve logical I/O without the massive memory penalty of LOOKUP_CACHE. Also explore caching only one lookup site while keeping SET_BASED or high bulk elsewhere.
LOOKUP_CACHE achieves low f1, while SET_BASED at s5 minimizes gets and memory. Testing ROW/BULK combinations with caches examines the minimum f1 boundary.
Test hybrid LOOKUP_CACHE and LOOKUP_SQL pairings to check if PGA overhead can be halved while lowering consistent gets, along with exploring row-level mixes.
Test caching on only one site with low memory loops to explore the trade-off gap between 2.5MB and 15MB, while testing BULK combinations against minimal PGA SET_BASED targets.
Evaluating ROW on s1/s3 with partial caching or SET_BASED mixing to explore the low-memory edge and find middle trade-offs between f1 and f2.
Test combinations of bulk processing with one lookup cache to optimize the trade-off between f1 and f2 around ~15MB PGA.
Test s4=LOOKUP_CACHE with s1=SET_BASED at varying s3 bulk limits, and explore remaining non-dominated low-PGA/low-gets balances.
Test s4=LOOKUP_CACHE with s1/s3 configurations that minimize f1 and PGA under 15MB, and explore remaining low-PGA configurations without cache.
Test the extreme all SET_BASED configuration to minimize consistent gets, while probing pure lookup caching and moderate bulk sizing to explore the memory vs I/O trade-off across distinct loops.

SET_BASED minimizes f2 while LOOKUP_CACHE minimizes f1. Combining SET_BASED on s1 and s3 with BULK on s5, and testing mixed caching, explores whether intermediate f1/f2 trade-offs can beat current frontiers.
Test BULK_5000 with SET_BASED s5 to check for lower f1, explore single-cache trade-offs (s2 cache only), and intermediate bulk sizes.

Test mixing BULK and SET_BASED variants with single-side caching or SET_BASED combinations to probe intermediate PGA vs f1 compromises, especially testing if s1=BULK + s3=BULK without LOOKUP_CACHE achieves low memory with s5=SET_BASED.

Test hybrid batching and cache configurations: pairing SET_BASED with bulk operations, exploring ROW with LOOKUP_SQL to lower memory further, and testing asymmetric cache/bulk sizing to find intermediate trade-offs.
Combine low-memory ROW on s1 or s3 with BULK or SET_BASED to test memory-sensitive Pareto boundaries.
Test combinations of ROW/BULK with single LOOKUP_CACHE and explore low-memory boundaries around s1=ROW or s3=ROW with SET_BASED and LOOKUP_CACHE variations.
Testing combinations of ROW with BULK or LOOKUP_CACHE for s1/s3 to explore intermediate memory and I/O trade-offs along the Pareto front between 1920KB and 15168KB.

Explores the interaction between s1=BULK with s3=ROW when cached, checks s1=ROW with s3=BULK_5000 cached for lower f1, tests BULK_50 combinations for f2 trade-offs, and probes s1=SET_BASED combined with cache.
Test ROW at s1 with BULK/LOOKUP_SQL at s3, and explore BULK_50/5000 combinations without cache on s1 to push Pareto trade-offs in the low-memory region.
Evaluate SET_BASED across loops to aggressively minimize logical I/O, along with moderate bulk and cache variants to map PGA versus buffer gets trade-offs.

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically cuts logical reads at the cost of PGA. Test SET_BASED combined with selective cache or BULK_50/500 with single cache to isolate memory overhead and find intermediate Pareto points.
LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically cuts f1 at the cost of PGA. Test SET_BASED at s5 with varied BULK sizes or explore combinations of mixed caches to find balanced Pareto points.
Test BULK_500 on LOOKUP_SQL to beat #16 PGA while keeping f1 low, and test BULK_50/BULK_500 with one cached lookup to probe the mid-range f1/PGA frontier.
Test caching only on s2 with BULK processing, and evaluate asymmetric BULK limits to explore intermediate trade-offs between memory overhead and logical reads.
Test combinations of BULK_50/BULK_500 with single-side caching or BULK_5000 to find optimal trade-offs between low logical reads and moderate PGA.
Test hybrid cache configurations with s1=BULK_50/s3=BULK_500 and s4=LOOKUP_CACHE to improve f1 around 5300 while keeping f2 minimized at the low bulk-size tiers.
Combine BULK_5000 in s1 with BULK_500 in s3 with LOOKUP_CACHE for potentially lower f1, and test SET_BASED in s1/s3 mixed with cached BULK.
Test hybrid BULK_500/BULK_5000 combinations across s1 and s3 with LOOKUP_SQL and SET_BASED s5 to check for lower f1 under 2600KB PGA.
Test BULK_5000/BULK_50 against SET_BASED combinations to probe the lowest I/O and PGA frontier without cache overhead, alongside minimal memory configurations.
Test pure SET_BASED transformations across all DML sites to drastically cut logical I/O, alongside balanced bulk and lookup-caching alternatives to map memory trade-offs.
LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically reduces logical I/O (f1) at high PGA cost (f2). Testing BULK_50 with cache and SET_BASED combined with cached loops explores intermediate trade-offs on the Pareto frontier.
Test BULK_5000 with LOOKUP_CACHE and SET_BASED s5 to seek lowest f1, plus hybrid caching (LOOKUP_CACHE on only one loop) to bridge memory overhead between low-PGA and low-gets regimes.
Test BULK_5000 with LOOKUP_SQL to see if logical I/O drops below 6253 without the large PGA cache cost, and test caching in s1 or s3 with lower bulk sizes.

Test single-cache configurations (s2=CACHE, s4=SQL) with low/moderate bulk limits to examine if PGA can be halved while retaining substantial get reductions, alongside testing BULK_5000 with s5=SET_BASED trade-offs.
Test s4=LOOKUP_CACHE combined with s2=LOOKUP_SQL under BULK_500/BULK_5000 to push f1 lower at ~15MB PGA, and evaluate intermediate ROW/BULK combinations.
Test hybrid row/bulk combinations with SET_BASED s5 and dual cache to seek non-dominated trade-offs between f1 ~2300-4300 and memory ~15-16MB.
Investigate low-memory trade-offs between ROW and BULK_50/500 with LOOKUP_SQL and SET_BASED at s5, testing s1=BULK_50/s3=ROW and asymmetric bulk variations to discover intermediate Pareto points.
Test asymmetric lookup caching and SET_BASED combinations with low-memory BULK configurations to uncover Pareto gaps between pure caching and pure SQL lookups.
Evaluating combinations mixing low-PGA SQL lookups and SET_BASED/BULK along the trade-off curve between low-memory (ROW/BULK with LOOKUP_SQL) and low-buffer-cache regimes.
Explore the full SET_BASED extreme to minimize consistent gets, along with moderate bulk batching and lookup caching variants to map the memory vs I/O trade-off frontier.
Evaluate bulk sizes combined with LOOKUP_CACHE to optimize f1, and test SET_BASED combinations to probe the f1 vs f2 tradeoff boundary.

LOOKUP_CACHE drives massive f1 drops at the cost of PGA, while SET_BASED minimizes PGA. Combining SET_BASED on s1 and s3 while caching s4/s2 or testing BULK with mixed cache explores intermediate trade-offs.
Test low-memory bulk combinations with set-based s5, and explore selective caching to find intermediate points between high cache memory and high SQL I/O.
Investigate hybrid lookups (caching only one table lookup) with s5=SET_BASED, and test intermediate bulk configurations to explore the trade-off gap between 2MB and 15MB PGA.
Evaluating combinations mixing BULK with ROW or testing s1=BULK with s3=SET_BASED to discover intermediate trade-offs between f1 and f2 around low memory overhead.
Test combinations of asymmetric bulk sizing and single-sided lookup caches with SET_BASED s5 to find finer trade-offs between low PGA (near 2MB) and low consistent gets.
Combine BULK and LOOKUP_CACHE asymmetric/hybrid configurations to target the unexplored trade-offs between f1 (2300-3300) and PGA overhead.
Test BULK_5000 combined with ROW or BULK_50/500 under LOOKUP_CACHE and SET_BASED s5 to test lowest f1 versus memory trade-offs, and explore BULK_5000 with s4 LOOKUP_CACHE.
Testing s1=ROW with s3=SET_BASED explores low memory configurations around f1=6294. Testing s1/s3 BULK with single LOOKUP_CACHE explores intermediate memory levels.
Test pure SET_BASED across all loops for minimal logical I/O, alongside varying bulk sizes and lookup caching to explore memory vs. gets trade-offs.
Test single-lookup caching combined with SET_BASED or smaller batch sizes to isolate memory bloat and explore low gets with moderate memory.
LOOKUP_CACHE achieves low f1, while ROW/BULK_50 on s1/s3 with LOOKUP_CACHE and variations of s5 (e.g., BULK_5000 or ROW) may reduce f1 further or offer better PGA efficiency.
Test caching on only one site with SET_BASED on the other to probe intermediate memory, and evaluate BULK_5000 with LOOKUP_SQL to separate cache memory overhead from bulk fetch benefits.
Test BULK_50 with LOOKUP_SQL and s5=SET_BASED to probe low PGA, combined with asymmetric single-cache options to balance PGA and consistent gets.
Test intermediate combinations between ROW and BULK with SET_BASED s5 to find minimal memory configurations, and single-cache variants to optimize memory versus gets trade-offs.
Investigate the low-memory Pareto region between ROW and BULK_50 by pairing SET_BASED or BULK on s1 with ROW on s3, and test ROW caching alone to improve intermediate trade-offs.
Test hybrid configurations combining SET_BASED with LOOKUP_CACHE, and explore intermediate low-memory SET_BASED combinations to bridge the trade-off front between f1 and f2.

Evaluating BULK_500/5000 combined with SET_BASED to test whether s1=BULK + s3=SET_BASED achieves lower f1 than s1=BULK_50 at low memory, and testing BULK_500 mixed with ROW under LOOKUP_CACHE for low f1.
Test BULK_5000 combinations with LOOKUP_CACHE and asymmetric ROW/BULK_5000 configurations to push Pareto boundary on f1 and balance memory tradeoffs.

Test pure set-based execution across all loops to dramatically minimize consistent gets, plus intermediate bulk alternatives with and without lookup caching to explore memory/IO trade-offs across independent loops.
Test combinations of SET_BASED DML loops with selective LOOKUP_CACHE, and explore BULK_5000/BULK_50 with cache to map the middle ground between lowest I/O (f1) and memory (f2).
Test caching on s1 alone vs s3 alone to isolate PGA impact (~15MB cache), and test BULK_5000 with SQL lookup to see if high bulk lowers f1 without cache memory overhead.
Combine LOOKUP_CACHE for s2 with SET_BASED or varying bulk limits to isolate minimal f1 and test intermediate memory levels between full caching and all-SQL lookups.

Test mixing bulk collection sizes with cache to minimize f1 below 2322 while varying s1/s3 cache and bulk levels, or test SET_BASED combinations on one side with caching on the other to probe trade-offs.
Test BULK combinations under LOOKUP_CACHE with s1=BULK_500 to optimize f1, and test SET_BASED at s1 or s3 paired with LOOKUP_SQL to optimize f2.
Test caching only in s4 while s1/s5 are set-based to isolate s4 cache memory impact, and test BULK_5000 with s3 set-based for low f1/low PGA balance.
Test combinations of ROW/BULK with LOOKUP_CACHE for s1/s3 along with SET_BASED s5 to find lower memory configurations on the cache frontier, and test SET_BASED with LOOKUP_SQL variants.
Test caching on s1 alone or with ROW on s3, explore smaller bulk sizes to reduce PGA, and evaluate whether BULK on s5 improves over SET_BASED when lookups are cached.
Test ROW in s5 combined with low-memory bulk/set-based or minimal cache to probe lower PGA boundary trade-offs.
Test pure SET_BASED across all loops for maximum I/O reduction, and probe cache lookups and moderate bulk sizing to explore memory-I/O trade-offs.
Test isolating LOOKUP_CACHE to a single site or combining BULK with SET_BASED to probe the trade-off between the huge f1 gains of caching and memory overhead.
Test mixed caching to balance memory and logical reads: cache only one lookup (s2 or s4) alongside BULK/SET_BASED, exploring the intermediate PGA range between 2.3MB and 15MB.
Evaluating intermediate bulk sizes with caching and exploring single-cache variants to bridge the gap between low PGA (2.3-2.7MB) and low consistent gets (2.3k).
Test hybrid designs mixing SET_BASED with BULK and selective LOOKUP_CACHE to bridge the trade-off gap between high-memory/low-I/O caching and low-memory SET_BASED executions.

Test single-lookup caching (s2=CACHE, s4=SQL) paired with BULK or SET_BASED to fill gaps between 2322 gets (high memory) and 6251 gets (low memory). Also explore low-overhead BULK combinations with s5=SET_BASED.
Test single-cache configurations combined with BULK_500/BULK_50 on s1 and s3=SET_BASED, aiming to find an intermediate trade-off between f1 and f2.

Eval 36 showed s1=ROW and s3/s5=SET_BASED achieves the lowest f2 memory (1984KB). Exploring s1=ROW with cached lookups or other variations can reveal improved Pareto boundaries across low f1 and low f2.
Test lower f2 boundaries and balance points combining ROW/BULK with LOOKUP_CACHE vs LOOKUP_SQL to refine non-dominated frontiers.

Evaluating BULK on S1 with LOOKUP_CACHE and ROW on S3 tests if intermediate f1/f2 trade-offs beat #46/#45. Also, testing ROW on S1/S3 with SET_BASED S5 and single LOOKUP_CACHE variants explores lower f2 regions.
Explore the full SET_BASED approach to drastically minimize consistent gets (f1), alongside moderate BULK and caching variants to establish baseline trade-offs across all three loop sites.
LOOKUP_CACHE achieves drastically lower f1, while SET_BASED on s5 reduces f1 and PGA. Testing BULK variants with s5=SET_BASED explores the memory-vs-I/O tradeoff.
Test configurations where caching is enabled for only one site or where bulk processing is combined with SQL lookups to explore intermediate PGA tiers between 2.3MB and 15MB.
LOOKUP_CACHE provides huge f1 drops at high PGA, while BULK variants on s1/s3 reduce gets when caching. Testing smaller bulk limits and isolated cache usages explores mid-tier PGA/f1 tradeoffs.
Test intermediate memory/IO points by isolating cache to s4 (lower PGA than s2 cache) with ROW/BULK combinations, and test s1=BULK_50/s3=SET_BASED to fill gaps near the low PGA region.
Testing SET_BASED on s1 combined with ROW/BULK on s3, exploring minimal memory combinations with s1/s3 set-based variants, and probing single-cache configurations.
Test BULK with LOOKUP_CACHE against ROW to find intermediate Pareto points between f1=4321 and f1=2322.
Test BULK_5000 with LOOKUP_CACHE and asymmetric combinations, plus fine-tuning s1/s3 BULK_5000 with SET_BASED to discover sharper trade-offs along the Pareto front.
Test BULK_5000 combined with BULK_50/500 to find minimal f1 when caching, and evaluate SET_BASED on s1 with ROW on s3 to seek low PGA improvements.
Evaluating BULK_50/BULK_500 for s1 with ROW for s3 to explore low-memory tradeoffs around the 2000-2300 KB region where s5=SET_BASED minimizes f1.
